urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo - shayela manje
urgent.primary_message: Shayela i-ambulensi ngokushesha. Hlafuna i-aspirin eyodwa uma ikhona. Ungazishayeli wena.
red_flags: Ubuhlungu besifuba, ingcindezi, ukucinana, noma ukumpintshana — okuhlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwemizuzu embalwa
Ubuhlungu obusakazekela engalweni (ngokuvamile kwesokunxele), umhlathi, intamo, iqolo, noma isisu
Ukuphefumula okungazelelwe, noma ngaphandle kobuhlungu besifuba
Ubuthakathaka obukhulu obungazelelwe, isiyezi, noma ukuquleka
Kwabesifazane: ukukhathala okungajwayelekile, ubuhlungu obunjengokuqunjelwa, noma iqolo

what_is_it.heading: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo ngesinye isikhathi
what_is_it.lede: Ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo kwenzeka lapho ukugeleza kwegazi kuya engxenyeni yemisipha yenhliziyo kuvaleka kungazelelwe. Umsipha uqala ukufa emizuzwini embalwa.
paragraphs: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo okuningi kubangelwa ihlule elakheka ku-fatty plaque ngaphakathi komthambo wenhliziyo. Ukuvinjelwa kubulala imisipha yenhliziyo yomoya-mpilo. Uma umthambo uvalekile isikhathi eside, imisipha iyafa.
Ukwelashwa kwesimanje esibhedlela kungavula umthambo ovalekile futhi kusindise inhliziyo esele - kodwa kuphela uma ufika lapho ngokushesha. Iminithi ngalinye lokulibaziseka liwumonakalo ongapheli.

items.headline: Isikhathi = umsipha
items.body: Umzuzu nomzuzu womthambo ovalekile ulahlekelwa imisipha yenhliziyo. Ukwelashwa emahoreni okuqala kungasindisa iningi lakho.

items.headline: Umbulali ohamba phambili
items.body: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo siyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa okungathathelwana eNingizimu Afrika.

items.headline: Atypical kwabesifazane
items.body: Abesifazane bavame ukuba nobuhlungu besifuba obungajwayelekile - esikhundleni salokho, ukukhathala, ubuhlungu bemihlathi, isicanucanu, noma ukuphelelwa umoya. Lezi zimpawu kulula ukuzichitha.

items.headline: Kuyagwemeka kakhulu
items.body: Ukubhema, umfutho wegazi ophakeme, isifo sikashukela, i-cholesterol ephezulu, ukungasebenzi, nokukhuluphala kushayela iningi lokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo. Konke kuyalawuleka.

pull_quote.text: Abantu abaningi ababulawa isifo senhliziyo bafa ngaphambi kokuba bafike esibhedlela - ngokuvamile ngoba babelindile, benethemba lokuthi kuzodlula. Uma ungenaso isiqiniseko, shayela.

signs.heading: Ongase uzizwe
signs.lede: Izimpawu zokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo azihlali zimangalisa. Izimpawu ezithambile kodwa ezibeleselayo zisadinga ukunakwa okuphuthumayo.

items.title: Ubuhlungu besifuba noma ingcindezi
items.description: Umuzwa osindayo, ocindezelayo, oqinile, noma oshisayo phakathi kwesifuba. Ihlala ngaphezu kwemizuzu embalwa, noma iza iphinde ihambe.

items.title: Ubuhlungu obusakazekela ngaphandle
items.description: Ubuhlungu noma ukuba ndikindiki engalweni (ngokuvamile kwesokunxele), umhlathi, intamo, iqolo, noma isisu esingaphezulu. Kungenzeka ngaphandle kobuhlungu besifuba.

items.title: Ukuphelelwa umoya
items.description: Kungazelelwe ubunzima bokuphefumula, ngezinye izikhathi uphawu olulodwa. Okuvame kakhulu kwabesifazane, abantu abadala, kanye nabantu abanesifo sikashukela.

items.title: Ukujuluka, isicanucanu, isiyezi
items.description: Umjuluko obandayo we-clammy, isicanucanu noma ukuhlanza, ubuthakathaka obungazelele noma ukuquleka. Ngokuvamile kuhlanganiswe nezimpawu ezingenhla.

items.myth: Ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo njalo kusho ubuhlungu besifuba obumangalisayo.
items.fact: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo okuningi kuqala ngokungaphatheki kahle futhi kwakha kancane. Abesifazane, abantu abadala asebekhulile, kanye nabantu abanesifo sikashukela bavame ukuba nezimpawu ze-atypical.

items.myth: Uma ngimncane futhi ngifanelekile, angikwazi ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo.
items.fact: Ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika kuyakhula - okuqhutshwa ukubhema, ukufutha, ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, umlando womndeni, kanye nezinkinga ze-cholesterol ezingatholakali.
Ubuhlungu obufana nesilungulela obuhlala njalo, obubuyayo, obufika nokujuluka noma ukuphelelwa umoya, noma obuzwakala buhlukile kobujwayelekile - kufanele buhlolwe.

items.myth: Ngizolinda ihora ukuze ngibone ukuthi liyadlula yini.
items.fact: Ukulinda yisona sizathu esikhulu esenza abantu babulawe yisifo senhliziyo. Uma ungenasiqiniseko isikhathi esingaphezu kwemizuzu eyi-10 — shayela i-ambulensi.

action_steps.heading: Okufanele ukwenze - lapho usola isifo senhliziyo

items.title: Shayela ku-10177 noma ku-112 ngokushesha
items.description: Ithi 'isifo senhliziyo esisolwayo'. Abezimo eziphuthumayo baqala ukwelashwa nge-ambulensi kanye nendlela eya esibhedlela esinamandla enhliziyo.

items.title: Hlafuna i-aspirin eyodwa evamile (300 mg) uma ikhona
items.description: Ukuhlafuna - ukungagwinyi ngokuphelele - kungenisa i-aspirin egazini ngokushesha. Yeqa uma i-allergic, ezintweni ezinciphisa igazi, noma usanda ukopha.

items.title: Hlala phansi uphumule. Khulula izingubo ezimpintshayo
items.description: Hlala ngokukhululeka. Ungaqambi amanga uma ukuphefumula kunzima. Hlala uzolile - ukwethuka kukhulisa ukucindezelwa kwenhliziyo.

items.title: Ungazishayeli wena
items.description: Uma uwela esondweni, ungafa futhi ulimaze abanye. Linda i-ambulensi — abezimo eziphuthumayo baphatha izinto ezisindisa ukuphila.

items.title: Bavulele abezimo eziphuthumayo umnyango
items.description: Qiniseka ukuthi bangakufinyelela ngokushesha. Uma uwedwa, fika endaweni lapho othile angakuthola khona.

get_help.heading: Ubani okumele ashayele khona manje
get_help.lede: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo okusolwayo kuyisimo esiphuthumayo. Ungalindi, ungashayeli, 'ungaboni ukuthi kuhamba kanjani'.

helplines.name: Isimo esiphuthumayo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifinyelela kunoma iyiphi isevisi yezimo eziphuthumayo ngomakhalekhukhwini
helplines.meta: Kumahhala kunoma iyiphi iselula · amahora angama-24
